name: lv_image_create_xip_thunk

ownership.argument: Borrowed live parent in r0, or NULL to create a screen; optional initialization-options byte pointer in r1. NULL options use native defaults. Non-NULL options are read synchronously; do not pass an invalid pointer.
ownership.return_value: Native LVGL image owned by its parent/display object tree; use the native object lifecycle. The wrapper does not check allocation failure before initialization.

provenance.source: Exact .043 AP bytes, startup-copy map, IDA target body and native calendar/CC call sites. Eight-byte XIP thunk jumps to 0x1c06cac0; existing lv_image_create canonical record is retained.

notes: Exact Resource Hook battery/calendar identity only. Audited ABI: void *(void *parent, const uint8_t *init_options); r2/r3 unused. No prototype field or new callable wrapper is exported. Preserve the second-argument contract instead of inheriting the canonical record's one-argument prototype. Restricted STATIC_RECOVERED/PENDING, device not_probed. No additional target, address range or transitive callee is authorized.
